newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-WAUGH CLEARED BY HOSPITAL TO RESUME IN FIRST TEST.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-WAUGH CLEARED BY HOSPITAL TO RESUME IN FIRST TEST.

text.p: Australian batsman Mark Waugh is suffering from a virus, not appendicitis as had been feared, a team spokesman said on Sunday.
He is being discharged from hospital and will be available to bat on the final two days of the first test against England.
The news was further encouragement for Australia after they had fought back from a first innings deficit of 360 to reach 256 for one in their second innings at the start of the fourth day's play.
Waugh was taken to hospital on Saturday after complaining of stomach pains.
